# Class `puc::properties::Properties`

Sole application gateway to TOML-backed configuration and runtime settings.

Immutable sources retain parsed documents for domain-specific consumers. Mutable sources contribute scalar defaults to the same global dotted-key directory. Runtime changes are kept in memory and survive reload; reload refreshes immutable documents and unmodified mutable defaults transactionally.
